answer: Terrace memory-hard attestation: each identity must hold 2 GB of RAM filled from a yarrow seed (its address+epoch), so 1,000 fakes need 2 TB live, not one shared box. Each epoch a verifier sends a random voyage of 64 pointer-chasing lookups through that table; any wrong value or a reply over 300 ms (disk or peer fetch) fails the seat. Tables are bound per address, so farms cannot share or precompute them, and each reward terrace doubles the size. Limit: a rich farm can rent RAM, but cost stays linear per fake.
